text:
rohan: bringing a weird mix of Switch carts + a spare dock on Friday for the LAN. leaving a small stack on the mezz table labeled 'FREEPLAY' — help yourselves. if you want to hold a game until later, say 'raincheck' and i'll tag it.
tess: heck yes. can you hold 'Axiom Verge' for me? raincheck pls, meetings all day. :pray:
benji: i'll take the spare dock if no one claims it. current dock at home is R.I.P. :sweat_smile: rohan: sure thing benji, i'll slap a sticky on it with your name.
marta: dropping off a sealed indie cartridge (mystery pick) and a USB-C hub — put it under the monitor cart so it doesn't wander. also quick PSA: if you snag a cart, please write your name on the tracker Google Sheet so we don't play musical cartridges. link: https://go.re/redwood-lan-sheet
rohan: ops-bot, can you pin the sheet link in #random for Friday?
ops-bot: Heads-up: #random pinned messages updated with LAN sign-up and the freeplay inventory. Event reminder set for Fri 6:15pm.
tess: thanks! also does anyone want to swap a Switch case? mine is trashed.
benji: i have a spare slim case, can bring. trade for the mystery pick? :eyes:
marta: low-key bring power strips too, friday outlets are always a drama.
rohan: adding two strips to my bag. last call for rainchecks before i label things at 4pm on Friday.
tess: confirmed raincheck for Axiom Verge. thx rohan.
benji: snagging the dock. see y'all Friday :rocket: 
marta: will leave a note on the mezz board about 'no food on the switch shelf' after last time. :face_with_head_bandage:
rohan: lol noted. tag me if someone tries to noodle-surf the carts.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please respect shared gear. If something breaks, file a ticket in #help with photo and description.
